about.heading: About Cedar-IBSi
body: Cedar Management Consulting International and IBS Intelligence run a shared events platform dedicated to the future of banking technology. Both firms curate a global Events & Awards calendar built for senior banking leadership, with FinTech innovators joining as event partners.
